inputs.rationale: A readonly IDL attribute takes no inputs; the getter steps are simply 'return this's [[ResponseHeaders]]' (editor's draft §6.3). What populates the slot is documented under value/lifecycle.

notes: Inventory is the complete developer-facing surface added by spec PR #713: one WebTransportOptions dictionary member and one WebTransport readonly attribute. Headers/HeadersInit and their guard semantics are external Fetch types, referenced not inventoried; wt-available-protocols and wt-protocol are wire-level headers owned by the separate protocols feature and are documented here only where they constrain these two members. The canonical github.com URLs for spec PR #713, issue #263, and WebKit PR 61874 returned HTTP 403 through this build environment's proxy, so the pages link the verified patch-diff.githubusercontent.com diffs instead and attribute issue #263 via the linked Intent to Ship. Behavior is source-derived, not runtime-verified: no flag-enabled Chrome 153 with a SETTINGS_ENABLE_WEBTRANSPORT server was available.
